caption:
Waist width decides where a ski performs: under about 85 mm for hardpack, 85 to 100 mm for all-mountain, past 100 mm for powder. Length: roughly between chin and top of head. Both AI models pick the Nordica Enforcer 94. Carving, powder and beginner picks: 1billionmodels.com

Two AI models (Claude Opus 5.5, GPT 6.1 Sol) chose with no web access; nobody tested these products. Synthetic voice. AI-made video.
title: What ski waist width do you need?
